name: Revenue waterfall through proxy fees, intermediaries, managers, and quota remittance

attribution.legal_posture: Official UN Panel synthesis of expert interviews and source-qualified examples; criminal finding, sanctions designation, and universal pattern fall outside the synthesis.

caveats: This aggregate finding retains payment context while excluding payment accounts and account-holder identities.
Evidence class: UN Panel synthesis of expert interviews.
The public record retains aggregate context; people, personas, accounts, companies, victims, payment identifiers, wallets, addresses, images, credentials, and raw technical selectors stay outside it.
The figures are expert estimates and ranges; audited totals and universal rates require broader data.
The record preserves an official-source operating model or case description; attribution rules or proof about an applicant, worker, nationality, or organization require separate evidence.

Use only lawful, proportionate, multi-signal review. Location, work-hour, VPN, remote-access, bidding, payment and code-quality signals require combination and corroboration before supporting fraud or DPRK attribution.

statements: Overseas workers were reported to handle several projects simultaneously; experts estimated typical monthly earnings of $3,000-$5,000 and substantially higher earnings for highly skilled workers.
Workers reportedly paid 5%-30% of income to proxy-account holders and usually 20%-30% to payment or laundering intermediaries, or a fixed monthly per-person fee.

After office, equipment, and living expenses, supervisors and managers received a share, the dispatching organization received a share, and funds were handed over to Pyongyang under a designated quota requirement.
limitations: Evidence class: UN Panel synthesis of expert interviews.
The figures are expert estimates and ranges, not audited totals or universal rates.
Do not expose payment accounts or identify account holders from this aggregate finding.
The record preserves an official-source operating model or case description; it is not a standalone attribution rule or proof about an applicant, worker, nationality, or organization.
Use only lawful, proportionate, multi-signal review. No single location, work-hour, VPN, remote-access, bidding, payment, or code-quality signal establishes fraud or DPRK attribution.
No people, personas, accounts, companies, victims, payment identifiers, wallets, addresses, images, credentials, or raw technical selectors are retained.
